_meta._comment: Phase 1 complete on real hardware 2026-07-28 (transport sanity — scan, connect, GATT, GAP/device-info reads, notification stream). Phase 2 complete 2026-07-29: commands.recording is VERIFIED via a 3/3 CameraSession round trip (see that block's provenance). ble_name re-confirmed by examples/scan_camera.py on v8.6 rather than inherited: the physical unit (BLE address CC:86:EC:72:E0:A6) is the same one upgraded from v7.9 on 2026-07-27, and the advertisement name identifies the hardware, not the firmware. Phase 3 complete 2026-07-30 for all three settings families: the passive settings sweep (step 9) populated `codecs`, most of `resolutions`, and the report-side coordinates of commands.codec_quality and commands.recording_format. commands.video_format and a partial fps_modes (23.98/24/30) were then added as explicit CANDIDATE hypotheses to unblock step 10 — see docs/settings.md 18.6. A follow-up dedicated fps sweep filled in the remaining fps_modes; 60fps's initial candidate-ceiling reading was retracted after three standalone retries (docs/settings.md 18.7/18.8) — fps_modes is 8/8. Step 10's full 0x00-0x1F dimension_enum sweep confirmed all 8 enums, matching both POCKET_6K_G2_v7.9's and POCKET_6K_PRO_v8.6's numbers exactly, and supplied HD's width/height. Step 12 (nine manual send_settings_command.py confirming writes, docs/settings.md 18.10) and step 13 (a 480-combination sweep_camera_format.py sweep, 432 confirmed) then promoted all three settings families — codec_quality, video_format, recording_format — to VERIFIED, exceeding the single-round-trip bar that promoted v7.9's equivalents. That same step-12/13 work surfaced two systematic gaps mirroring both other profiles' precedents. The BRAW@6K@59.94/60fps ceiling (16/16 sweep failure) was promoted the same day: the operator confirmed on the camera's own UI that 6K doesn't offer those fps values, meeting design principle 7's evidence bar — `resolutions."6K".max_fps_int` is now `50`. The ProRes/4K DCI retarget gap (3 manual attempts plus a systematic 32/32 sweep failure) was promoted to `known_unreachable` 2026-07-31 (docs/settings.md 18.12): the operator ran the same three falsification hypotheses that closed the PRO's identical gap (data-type byte, Operation.OFFSET, exact fps/variant) three times each, from three different starting states and Sensor Area settings, and all 9 attempts stayed silent. A genuine open discrepancy in the recording_format flags field's UHD reading — 0x0000 twice, 0x0010 twice — remains unresolved (docs/settings.md 18.10); a dedicated repeat probe for it is still planned. _meta.status stays UNVERIFIED because it describes the WHOLE profile: `capabilities` and `storage` are still entirely unpopulated on this firmware (matching why v7.9 also stayed UNVERIFIED despite every command family there being individually VERIFIED). Each command block carries its own provenance.status — recording, codec_quality, video_format, and recording_format are now all VERIFIED.

provenance.notes: Re-sniffed on v8.6, not inherited from the v7.9 profile (design principle 6) — and the reserved byte genuinely differs, which is why that matters. RESERVED BYTE INDIFFERENT: the 2026-07-29 sweep sent all four (value, reserved) combinations and the camera acted on every one, so 0x00 and 0x01 both work; v7.9 records 0x01, this profile records 0x00. 0x00 is canonical here because it is the only reserved value with a clean wire echo for BOTH outcomes (start 'FF 0A 00 00 0A 01 01 02 02 00 40 00 01 03', stop 'FF 0A 00 00 0A 01 01 02 00 00 40 00 01 03'), and because it matches the reserved byte the camera itself uses in every camera-originated report on this family. The reserved=0x01 start candidate was operator-confirmed only — its capture window caught the post-connect initial-payload burst instead of the response (the known first-candidate race in docs/command_discovery.md's safety model), so it has no echo of its own; reserved=0x01 stop did echo cleanly. Echo payload trailing bytes '00 40 00 01 03' are identical to v7.9's and remain not understood (hypothesis: SDI Cat 10 Param 1 transport-mode struct, docs/protocol.md). PROMOTED TO VERIFIED 2026-07-29 on Phase 2 steps 8.4 and 8.5: send_record_command.py produced clean echoes for both directions, then examples/record_start_stop.py ran the real CameraSession echo-verified round trip 3/3 start, 3/3 stop, 0/3 stopped early, clip durations 7s/5s/4s. Every TX in that run was byte-exact to this block ('FF 05 00 00 0A 01 01 00 02' / '... 00 00', 3 each), so the reserved=0x00 choice is confirmed through the production write path, not just the discovery tool. TIMECODE also read 00:00:00:00 at each start, matching docs/timecode.md's finding that the camera resets it on record start.

provenance.notes: WRITE SIDE NOW CONFIRMED (docs/settings.md 18.10), using this block's own coordinates (data_type INT16/0x02, reserved 0x00) rather than v7.9's write-side 0x82/reserved-0x01 pair — send_settings_command.py's default already builds packets from this profile block, so no `--data-type` override was needed. Run 5 (2026-07-30) retargeted BRAW from 4K DCI to 6K at 30fps and got a clean echo 'FF 0E 00 00 01 09 02 02 1E 00 1E 00 00 18 80 0D 00 00' (fps=30, width=6144, height=3456, flags=0x0000). Run 9 retargeted from a ProRes/HD baseline to UHD at 50fps and also echoed cleanly (fps=50, width=3840, height=2160, flags=0x0000). PROMOTED TO VERIFIED 2026-07-30: sweep_camera_format.py's 480-combination CameraSession.set_camera_format() run confirmed 432 combinations end to end, exceeding the single-round-trip bar that promoted v7.9's block. KNOWN GAP, MATCHING BOTH OTHER PROFILES' PRECEDENT — NOT YET A known_unreachable ENTRY: retargeting to 4K DCI while ProRes is the active codec never confirms on this firmware. Runs 6, 7, and 8 (2026-07-30) each attempted this retarget (30fps once, 30fps repeated, 50fps repeated) from a ProRes/HD baseline and got no 0x01/0x09 report in any of the five attempted windows, while Run 9's UHD retarget from the identical baseline (a separate connection, same ProRes/HD/29.97fps starting state) confirmed cleanly — isolating the failure to the (ProRes, 4K DCI) combination specifically, not a general write-path problem. The sweep's own systematic result agrees exactly: all 32 ProRes x 4K DCI x fps combinations were unconfirmed (6.1-7.9s each, at the 6.0s echo timeout), while the other 3 resolutions under ProRes (HD, UHD) confirmed cleanly at every fps. This is the same shape of finding as POCKET_6K_PRO v8.6's ProRes/4K DCI known_unreachable entry (docs/settings.md 16). PROMOTED TO known_unreachable 2026-07-31 (docs/settings.md 18.12): the operator ran the same falsification hypotheses that closed the PRO's gap — the data_type byte (0x82/INT16_ARRAY retry), Operation.OFFSET (a genuine +256 in-range width delta via --raw-payload), and an exact-fps retry (59.94, matching the camera's own current fps in one of the three runs) — three times each, from three different starting states and Sensor Area settings (6K, 2.8K, 5.3K), specifically to also rule out Sensor Area as a confound. All 9 attempts produced zero recording_format echoes. See resolutions."4K DCI".known_unreachable.ProRes for the guarded field and its own note. FLAGS FIELD — OPEN, UNRESOLVED DISCREPANCY (not the settled finding this block previously claimed): element 5 is 0x0000 at every full-sensor resolution tried (6K here in Run 5, and originally in the step 9 passive capture) and 0x0010 at every windowed/cropped resolution — except UHD, which has now been read as 0x0000 twice (step 9's original passive capture, and Run 9 above) and as 0x0010 twice (the step 10 dimension_enum sweep's printed summary, and Run 3's fresh ProRes/HD->UHD/25fps transition, docs/settings.md 18.10) — an even 2-2 split, not resolved by majority and not silently picked either way here. See docs/settings.md 18.10 for the full write-up and open theories (a real, independently-toggled sensor-mode bit rather than a static per-resolution property is one candidate, given the closed-but-related Sensor Area investigation in docs/photo_capture.md 10.1-10.7). 23.98fps and other NTSC/drop rates add 0x0003 on top (0x0013 total) where exact rates stay at the base value — reconfirmed by the full fps sweep (docs/settings.md 18.7): every NTSC/drop rate (23.98/29.97/59.94) shows +0x0003, every exact rate (24/25/30/50/60) shows the base value. RETRACTED FINDING: fps_60 initially looked silent across two sweeps and was recorded as a candidate ceiling; three follow-up standalone attempts reported it cleanly twice (2/3), byte-identical to each other and matching the exact-rate pattern — see docs/settings.md 18.8. The camera demonstrably reaches and reports this state, so there is no ceiling here; the three silent attempts (2 original + 1 of the 3 retries) are an open report-observability question, not a capability finding. SEPARATE HARDWARE CEILING, PROMOTED TO A max_fps_int ENTRY 2026-07-30: the sweep found all 16 BRAW@6K@59.94/60fps combinations (all 8 variants, both fps) unconfirmed (6.1-6.3s, at the 6.0s echo timeout), the same shape as POCKET_6K_PRO v8.6's confirmed 6K/50fps ceiling (docs/settings.md 17). Design principle 7's evidence bar is now met: the operator directly confirmed on the camera's own UI, the same day, that 6K does not offer 59.94/60fps as options — `resolutions."6K".max_fps_int` is now `50`, guarding `set_video_format`/`set_recording_format` and excluded by default from `sweep_camera_format.py`'s combination space. See that resolution entry's own `_comment` for the full write-up.

provenance.notes: RESOLVES THE 'WEAKEST FIELD' CONCERN THIS BLOCK ORIGINALLY FLAGGED: sweep_dimension_enum.py always encodes with reserved=spec.reserved (no override path in that tool — confirmed by reading its source, not inferred from the summary alone), so all 32 sends in this run used reserved=0x01, the value already in this block. 8 clean matches at that reserved byte is real confirmation it works, not just a surviving hypothesis. THE 8 CONFIRMED ENUMS MATCH BOTH POCKET_6K_G2_v7.9's AND POCKET_6K_PRO_v8.6's NUMBERS EXACTLY: 0x03 HD, 0x06 UHD, 0x08 4K DCI/BRAW, 0x0D 2.8K 17:9/BRAW, 0x0F 3.7K Anamorphic/BRAW, 0x12 5.7K 17:9/BRAW, 0x13 6K/BRAW, 0x14 6K 2.4:1/BRAW — independently sniffed on this firmware's own wire (design principle 6), not copied; the cross-profile agreement is a finding, not the source. video_format's own channel (0x01/0x00) still never echoes on this firmware, matching every other camera tried — the write is confirmed exclusively through the collateral recording_format (0x01/0x09) mode-notify report, same as v7.9. NO REGRESSION FROM THE LENS-BURST-DELAY HAZARD: Run 4 (2026-07-30, docs/settings.md 18.10) reproduced on this firmware, for the first time, the delayed-echo pattern already documented for the PRO (docs/settings.md 15) — the confirming report for send 1/2 arrived inside send 2/2's capture window instead of its own, still well inside CameraSession's actual echo_timeout_s, just outside the fixed tooling window used to observe it. Run 3 also reconfirmed the redundant-write-suppresses-report behaviour for this family (send 2/2, an identical resend, produced no report at all) — the same result docs/settings.md 13/14 already established on v7.9, now independently re-observed on this firmware rather than assumed to carry over (design principle 6). PROMOTED TO VERIFIED 2026-07-30: sweep_camera_format.py's 480-combination CameraSession.set_camera_format() run confirmed 432 combinations end to end via this family's real production write path, exceeding the single-round-trip bar (examples/change_codec.py) that promoted v7.9's block. Same known gap as both other profiles: no ProRes/4K DCI enum found anywhere in the exhausted 0x00-0x1F range, and the sweep's systematic 32/32 failure for that (codec, resolution) pair under every fps agrees — now promoted to resolutions.'4K DCI'.known_unreachable.ProRes on this profile (2026-07-31, docs/settings.md 18.12) — see commands.recording_format's provenance for the full write-up. Each matched dimension_enum also reset codec_quality to a per-codec-family default (ProRes->HQ, BRAW->5:1), reconfirming on this firmware the already-established mechanism (docs/settings.md) where a codec-family switch via video_format resets/restores quality rather than codec_quality itself switching families.

resolutions._comment: Widths/heights sniffed on v8.6 2026-07-30 from 0x01/0x09 reports (step 9, passive); dimension_enums added 2026-07-30 from a full 0x00-0x1F active sweep (step 10, tools/control/sweep_dimension_enum.py --fps 24) — see commands.video_format's provenance for the sweep's full evidentiary detail. All 8 confirmed enums match both POCKET_6K_G2_v7.9's and POCKET_6K_PRO_v8.6's numbers exactly, independently sniffed here rather than copied (design principle 6). HD's width/height came from this same sweep: its own passive capture window (step 9) had caught the post-connect burst instead of a report, so this profile went without HD until the active probe supplied it directly via the 0x01/0x09 transition at enum 0x03. No ProRes/4K DCI enum found anywhere in the exhausted range — the same known gap already documented on both other profiles — but NOT yet promoted to known_unreachable here; that needs the fuller write-value investigation (data_type, Operation, the two-step proxy) neither of those profiles' gap-closing work has been repeated on this firmware yet. UPDATE (2026-07-30, docs/settings.md 18.10): the same gap now has independent write-side corroboration — three manual recording_format retarget attempts (Runs 6-8) and a systematic 32/32 sweep failure across every ProRes variant and fps at 4K DCI, contrasted with a clean UHD retarget from the identical baseline (Run 9) and 400/400 clean confirmations everywhere else in the sweep. PROMOTED 2026-07-31 (docs/settings.md 18.12): the operator then exhausted the same three falsification hypotheses that closed the PRO's identical gap, three times each from different starting states — see resolutions."4K DCI".known_unreachable.ProRes and commands.recording_format's provenance for the full evidence. A parallel candidate ceiling also surfaced the same day: all 16 BRAW@6K@59.94/60fps sweep combinations were unconfirmed, the same shape as POCKET_6K_PRO v8.6's confirmed 6K/50fps max_fps_int. UPDATE (2026-07-30): operator confirmed on the camera's own UI that 6K does not offer 59.94/60fps — design principle 7's evidence bar is now met, and resolutions."6K".max_fps_int is promoted to 50 (see that entry's own _comment and commands.recording_format's provenance). The `codecs` list per entry records which codec family the operator reached that resolution under on the camera's own menus. 2.8K 17:9's width (2880) is now confirmed three ways on this firmware: the step 9 passive capture, this step 10 active probe, and a direct visual check of the camera's own on-screen display (operator-confirmed, 2026-07-30) — no ambiguity remains for v8.6. The v7.9 profile still records 2868 for the same label; whether that was ever accurate for v7.9 specifically remains unresolved and unfalsifiable now that camera can no longer be re-tested (see docs/settings.md 18.1). Do not reconcile the two profiles by editing either value — the discrepancy is about v7.9's own history, not about v8.6's number, which is settled.

6K._comment: CONFIRMED 2026-07-30 (docs/settings.md 18.10): sweep_camera_format.py's 480-combination production run found all 8 BRAW variants unconfirmed at 59.94/60fps here (16/16, 6.1-6.3s each at the 6.0s echo timeout), every other fps (23.98-50) confirming cleanly for all 8 variants, and 6K 2.4:1 (a different resolution, same sensor-mode family) confirming cleanly at every fps including 59.94/60 -- a systematic, codec-variant-independent, resolution-specific pattern, the signature of a real ceiling rather than a write bug. Operator confirmed the same day that the camera's own UI does not offer 59.94/60fps as options at 6K either -- a genuine hardware/sensor-readout limit, not a software write-path gap (contrast resolutions."4K DCI".known_unreachable, a software gap the camera itself does not have). Matches POCKET_6K_PRO v8.6's identical finding (same max_fps_int=50) but independently confirmed on this firmware's own captures, not inherited (design principle 6). max_fps_int=50 now guards this in CameraSession.set_video_format/set_recording_format and is excluded by default from sweep_camera_format.py's combination space.

known_unreachable.ProRes: Accepted capability gap, 2026-07-31 (docs/settings.md §18.10/§18.12 for the full evidentiary write-up). §18.10 already showed a systematic 32/32 sweep_camera_format.py failure plus 3 manual retarget attempts. The operator then ran the three falsification hypotheses that closed POCKET_6K_PRO v8.6's identical gap (§16) three separate times each, from three genuinely different starting states and Sensor Area settings (6K, 2.8K, 5.3K), targeting UHD/ProRes as the precondition each time: (1) the write-side data_type byte v7.9 used (0x82/INT16_ARRAY) instead of this profile's own 0x02, (2) Operation.OFFSET with a genuine in-range +256 width delta (not an absolute payload) via --raw-payload, and (3) a retarget attempt at 59.94fps — in the third session this exactly matched the camera's own current fps, closing the 'wrong fps' explanation as tightly as it can be closed without also matching ProRes PXY as the variant. All 9 attempts (3 hypotheses x 3 sessions) produced zero recording_format echoes — the same silent signature as every earlier attempt. Sensor Area was varied across the three sessions specifically to rule out that confound and had no effect either. This codebase's write path cannot reach the combination, but nothing here demonstrates the camera itself cannot hold it — the PRO's own investigation (§16) confirmed via a passive capture of its body menu that the identical combination is genuinely reachable and reported on that camera; the equivalent body-menu confirmation has not been separately gathered on this firmware, so known_unreachable is written on the strength of the exhausted write-side investigation alone. This is a software capability gap in this codebase's BLE write path, not evidence the camera-side combination is unsupported — never remove 'ProRes' from the codecs list above on the strength of this note. CameraSession.set_camera_format raises BMDUnsupportedError immediately for this (codec, resolution) pair rather than attempting a write known to fail.

fps_modes._comment: 8 of 8 modes, all CANDIDATE. fps_int and frame_flags read directly off v8.6's own 0x01/0x09 reports (2026-07-30, docs/settings.md 18/18.7/18.8), all at 2.8K 17:9 BRAW: 23.98 -> flags 0x0013, 24 -> 0x0010, 25 -> 0x0010, 29.97 (encodes as fps_int 30) -> 0x0013, 30 -> 0x0010 (reconfirmed byte-identical across two separate sweep sessions), 50 -> 0x0010, 59.94 (encodes as fps_int 60) -> 0x0013, 60 -> 0x0010 (reconfirmed byte-identical across two of five attempts — see docs/settings.md 18.8; the other three attempts were silent for reasons not fully explained, but that is a report-observability question, not evidence against reachability, since the camera demonstrably reaches and reports this exact state). m_rate IS THE ONE INFERRED FIELD in every entry: it is a video_format element and video_format never reports passively, so it cannot be observed at all until step 10's active probe. The inference is grounded in this firmware's own wire rather than another profile: the windowed-sensor bit is 0x0010, so an extra 0x0003 on top (0x0013 total) is the NTSC/drop indicator, giving m_rate=1 for 23.98/29.97/59.94 and 0 for the five exact rates. Confirmed or refuted by step 10/12.
